name: Nuclino
description: Nuclino is a collaborative workspace that unifies team knowledge, documentation, and light project management in a single, fast, simple tool.
best_for: Teams from startups to large organizations (site names NASA, Ubisoft, MIT, Paddle among 12,000+ teams) wanting to reduce tool fragmentation by consolidating knowledge, docs, and projects in one place.
features: Unified workspace combining docs, wiki, and project boards to eliminate silos
Instant full-text search and keyboard shortcuts, optimized for speed
Cross-platform apps: web, desktop (Win/Mac/Linux), and mobile (iOS/Android)

alternatives.name: Slab
alternatives.description: A company wiki/knowledge platform emphasizing fast search and knowledge discovery.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a dedicated, well-structured company wiki rather than combined project management.

alternatives.name: Archbee
alternatives.description: A knowledge portal platform for building searchable, customer-facing documentation portals.
alternatives.best_for: Technical teams that need external-facing docs/self-service support portals.
